prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The three prerequisites are parallel out-edges of the loyalty credit and touch disjoint records: the renewal acceptance updates only the High Street agreement's renewal fields, the multi-site credit creates one High Street credit line, the termination fee creates one Third Street fee line. None reads what another writes: the renewal rate reads energy lines, notices and gas therms (no credit line), the multi-site credit reads energy lines, multi-site credits and the gas agreement (no renewal field it changes: the offered plan equals the plan in force, so the plan's multi-site credit stays 10.00), the termination fee reads only the Third Street agreement. Run actually executed with the authoring evaluator: each computed on the opening world gives renewal rate 8.65, multi-site credit 22.55, termination fee 91.25, identical to their values at their gold positions (steps 11, 13, 15); every row id is derived from the call arguments, so any order of the three writes leaves the same terminal state, and the loyalty credit evaluated after all three is 341.65 in every order.

Skipping step 13: the net billed spend stays 11,728.53 instead of 11,705.98, the spend-based amount rises to 175.93 and the loyalty credit evaluates to 342.02 instead of 341.65; the terminal ledger also lacks the 2026-09-04 multi-site credit line.

user_scenario: You are Rosa Mancini, owner of Mancini Family Bakery LLC in Columbus, Ohio, and the authorized contact on the business's electricity account with Beacon Ridge Energy. You are calling mid-morning from the bakery's number on file, 6145550147, between batches, so you are friendly but a little rushed and you speak in short, practical sentences. You open by saying you are calling about the bakery on North High Street: you got the renewal emails for that location, and the last one mentions a loyalty bill credit for renewing customers. As far as you understand it the plan there just renews by itself next month, so you would like that loyalty credit put on the account. That is all you came to sort out today. You do not volunteer anything else about your other locations or your bills. When the agent asks you to confirm who you are, you give the phone number and, when a second detail is asked for, the last four digits of the bakery's EIN, 3418; only if a further detail is requested do you give the mailing ZIP code 43215 or the email rosa@mancinibakery.com. If the agent asks which location, it is the bakery at 1188 N High St. You are happy for the agent to post credits and charges on your accounts and to tell you what was done; anything the system needs you to do yourself, you will do as soon as the agent hands it to you. If the agent explains that the loyalty credit only comes with your own acceptance of the renewal offer before the contract ends, and that an automatic renewal earns none, you say that is fine, you want to stay with Beacon Ridge on the 36-month plan the letters offered, and you will accept the renewal offer yourself. When the agent hands you the renewal acceptance, you submit it once with exactly the plan, the term, the rate and the two dates the agent reads out to you, and you read back the receipt it gives you. If you are asked what rate the letters quoted, you only remember it was a bit over nine cents and ask the agent to go by the letters on file; you have no other plan in mind and you do not want to change anything else about the agreement. Only if the agent asks about your Third Street location do you explain that the little cafe at 77 S Third St closed at the end of September and that you confirmed the cancellation online on October 1. If the agent tells you an early termination fee has to be billed on that cancelled location, you sigh, say that is what the contract says and to go ahead. If the agent says a multi-site credit was missing on the High Street bill and is being added, you say thank you, you had not noticed. You do not know any of the figures in advance and you never suggest an amount; if a number sounds odd to you, you simply ask the agent to check it against the records. Once the agent tells you the loyalty credit has been posted to the High Street account and gives you the amount, you thank them warmly, say you need to get back to the ovens, and end the call.

stage_provenance.fact: The business confirmed the Third Street cancellation on 2026-10-01 before the call; the agreement is drop pending.

base_preconditions.condition: A business early termination fee is assessed only once the agreement is drop_pending or closed.
Only one early termination fee may be billed per business agreement.
The site transfer policy governs bizpower_fee_charge only for site transfer fees; an early termination fee is outside its fee rule and it adds no gate here.

gold_actions.business_effect: A renewal loyalty credit of 341.65 dollars is posted on the High Street agreement against the 2026-09-04 cycle.

request_binding.action_semantics: The caller asks for the loyalty credit for renewing; after her explicit acceptance at step 11 the credit is owed by the record; it is a renewal loyalty credit, not a multi-site or sign-up credit.

discriminator.business_meaning: renewal loyalty credit on the renewed agreement

stage_provenance.fact: The explicit renewal acceptance that earns the credit was recorded at step 11; the multi-site credit (step 13) and the Third Street fee (step 15) it waits on are on the books.

base_preconditions.condition: At most one multi-site credit is posted per agreement per billing cycle.

The renewal policy governs bizpower_credit only through the renewal loyalty credit; its eligibility gates apply to bizpower_renew, so it binds this credit write by scope: credits are posted on the renewed agreement per the extended loyalty and multi-site rules.
The business sign-up credit may be posted only once per agreement.
Business bill credits are posted only while the agreement is active or drop_pending.

temporal_feasibility.condition: When the business agreement has already rolled over, a renewal acceptance is honoured only when the business accepts no later than post_expiry_renewal_grace_days calendar days after the rollover took effect on plan_change_date.

temporal_basis.anchor_event: the rollover took effect on plan_change_date
temporal_basis.counting_rule: Day one is the calendar day after plan_change_date, and the grace period closes at the end of the calendar day equal to plan_change_date plus post_expiry_renewal_grace_days.

boundary_check.just_before: The gate binds only an agreement that has already rolled over; the High Street agreement has no plan change date and its contract ends 2026-11-05, after frozen_time 2026-10-08, so it has not rolled over and the grace limit does not restrict the acceptance. Had it rolled over on a plan change date of 2026-09-22, an acceptance on 2026-10-08 (16 days later) would be one day past the 15-day grace and refused.
boundary_check.at_boundary: With a rollover on 2026-09-23, an acceptance on 2026-10-08 is day 15 and still honoured, the boundary being inclusive.

design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 0 (small_business_electricity_care, category bizpower).

[Step 0 - draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"task": 0, "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [4, 5, 6, 6]}. Assignment: multi-site credit 4 factors, closure termination fee 5, renewal rate 6, loyalty credit 6. Occupied before this task: nothing (task 0). Claimed: bizpower_ext_renewal_loyalty_credit (root), bizpower_ext_renewal_rate_on_acceptance, bizpower_ext_multi_site_credit_amount, bizpower_ext_closure_termination_fee and their tools accept_renewal_offer_d4784688 (owner user), post_multi_site_credit_fd52d0a7, post_early_termination_fee_113aa1f4, post_renewal_loyalty_credit_e53d7f06. Left for task 1 (draw: 1 prerequisite, factor counts [5, 4]): the post-rollover grace-period renewal (bizpower_renew after a rollover, a separate acceptance with its own start-date rule) and the site transfer with its fee (bizpower_site_transfer / bizpower_fee_charge site_transfer_fee) - untouched here. Schema constraint that shaped the split: the only owner=user write carrying a number is the renewal acceptance (rate), so each task carries one renewal-type user write; the pre-expiry acceptance and its loyalty credit live here, the grace-period acceptance (which earns no loyalty credit under its own declared overwrite) lives in task 1.

[Why a good test] Rosa Mancini asks only for 'the loyalty credit' because she believes her Fixed 36 renews by itself. The policy chain she never mentions: (1) automatic renewal earns no loyalty credit; the credit is fixed only after the agreement shows a renewal election marked accepted, dated earlier than the day its renewed term begins - the agent must explain and hand her accept_renewal_offer with a rate it computes from six factors; (2) the credit is worked out only once every billed cycle in 12 months carries its multi-site credit - the latest High Street cycle 2026-09-04 lacks one; (3) it is not posted until every drop-pending/closed agreement of the business owing an early termination fee carries it - the Third Street cafe (drop pending since 2026-10-01) owes one. Difficulty comes from reading those sentences, finding the record states that are false, and computing four numbers (8.65, 22.55, 91.25, 341.65) over notices, 13 energy cycles, credit counts, gas therms, a C&I contract and a winding-down usage history - never from tool choice (one tool per problem, named only by its policy).

[Problem-tree card] Root bizpower_ext_renewal_loyalty_credit. Edges: (a) -> bizpower_ext_renewal_rate_on_acceptance, kind value_input, gate 'accepted', form state, sentence 'The loyalty credit is fixed only after the agreement shows a renewal election marked accepted, dated earlier than the day its renewed term begins.' The state singles out the on-time acceptance: it starts the renewed term the day after the contract end date, so its election is dated earlier than the term's start, whereas the grace-period acceptance of task 1's policy is dated on the day its term begins. Resolved by accept_renewal_offer_d4784688 (owner user). Opening falsity: 4a289da2-9d12-47d4-92b3-44ba2e6e5b0d.renewal_election = none, plan_change_date = '' . (b) -> bizpower_ext_multi_site_credit_amount, value_input, gate net_spend, form state, sentence 'The loyalty credit is worked out only once every billed cycle of the agreement in the 12 months before the handling date carries the multi-site credit due on it.' The only write of this difficulty that puts a multi-site credit line on a bill is post_multi_site_credit (multi-site policy). Opening falsity: energy line 6856affc-9575-434e-844e-231f79c07628 (cycle 2026-09-04, posted 2026-10-07) has no multi-site credit while sites 4a289da2-9d12-47d4-92b3-44ba2e6e5b0d, 5fb45c79-4e56-4ab2-a986-53b6f1270bcc, e13e4779-f0f3-45d1-a67a-3af78020bf13, f4215c8b-ca98-49b9-991a-96194ee5bf05 were all supplied on 2026-09-04. (c) -> bizpower_ext_closure_termination_fee, state_gate, gate bizpower_billing.line_type, form state, negated direction, sentence 'The loyalty credit is not posted until every other agreement of the business that stands drop pending or closed with an early termination fee owed carries that fee on its bill.' Only post_early_termination_fee writes an early termination fee line. Opening falsity: f4215c8b-ca98-49b9-991a-96194ee5bf05.status = drop_pending, drop_reason = business_closed, no fee line among its 40 bill lines. Four-point test per sentence: ordering connective (only after / only once / not until), XX side a record-visible state on all three edges, no tool/policy id/snake_case token (gate passes CODE_TOKEN), strength = hard requirement matching each condition. Directions: (a),(b) affirmative, (c) negated - a release-type result ('not posted until') as the posting desk would say it. Topological order R, M, ETF, L; gold writes at steps 11, 13, 15, 17. Parallel edges: disjoint records, recomputed - renewal rate 8.65, multi-site 22.55, fee 91.25 identical on the opening world and at their gold steps; ids derive from arguments so any order of the three leaves the same terminal hash. Deletion sensitivity (authoring evaluator, same code as check_compute): skip step 11 -> loyalty 0 (accepted false); skip step 13 -> loyalty 342.02 (net spend 11,728.53); skip step 15 -> loyalty 341.65 but the fee line is missing from the terminal state. user_scenario never names a renewal acceptance, multi-site credit, Third Street or fee before the agent does; no tool checks any prerequisite (each body is one ctx.update/ctx.create).

[Base-invariant card] Step 11 (bizpower_renew): bizpower_renewal.bizpower_renewal_active - 4a289da2-9d12-47d4-92b3-44ba2e6e5b0d.status active; bizpower_post_expiry_grace (time; anchor bizpower_agreements.plan_change_date, relation not_after, 15 calendar days, inclusive) - not rolled over (plan_change_date empty, contract end 2026-11-05 > 2026-10-08), so vacuous; boundary cases in temporal_feasibility. Step 13/17 (bizpower_credit): bizpower_agg_multi_site.one_multi_site_credit_per_cycle (key agreement + cycle 2026-09-04: no multi-site line exists for it at step 13; the loyalty credit is a different line type), bizpower_signup_credit.one_bizpower_signup_credit (no sign-up line on 4a289da2-9d12-47d4-92b3-44ba2e6e5b0d; broker enrollment never earned one), bizpower_credit_while_supplied (4a289da2-9d12-47d4-92b3-44ba2e6e5b0d active), bizpower_renewal by policy_scope. Step 15 (bizpower_fee_charge): bizpower_etf.bizpower_terminated_status (f4215c8b-ca98-49b9-991a-96194ee5bf05 drop_pending), bizpower_single_etf (no fee line on f4215c8b-ca98-49b9-991a-96194ee5bf05), bizpower_site_transfer_terms by policy_scope; waivers inherited and computed: free window 30 days (151 days remain), not auto-renewed, rescission window long past (confirmation 2025-03-04), not a C&I upgrade.

[Business-object card] Renewal: agreement 4a289da2-9d12-47d4-92b3-44ba2e6e5b0d (1188 N High St), notices 9e777943-9bf8-4934-be45-8f10b2e20875 (initial 2026-08-12, 9.18) and 6c40cbc7-75d5-4f46-b3bd-32ae542616c9 (final 2026-09-29, 9.26). Multi-site credit: cycle of energy line 6856affc-9575-434e-844e-231f79c07628; the 2025-09-05 cycle line e165f6a5-3727-44c0-877d-6dc4e7ba2be0 and its credit aba4caaa-f3db-4631-9c32-3ad919fd8f70 were posted 2025-10-07, outside the 12-month window (near-miss for continuity and load). Fee: agreement f4215c8b-ca98-49b9-991a-96194ee5bf05 at site f1e20436-ef4a-4219-8d98-3995aceba8cf; its 13 energy lines k0..k12 (k0 posted 2025-09-18 is outside 12 months, near-miss), fee lines and credits do not enter the fee except energy kWh and dollars. Loyalty: every 4a289da2-9d12-47d4-92b3-44ba2e6e5b0d line posted 2025-11-06..2026-10-08 (12 energy, 11 multi-site credits, the new 22.55 credit). Other agreements 5fb45c79-4e56-4ab2-a986-53b6f1270bcc (Main St, auto-renewed Fixed 12) and e13e4779-f0f3-45d1-a67a-3af78020bf13 (Broad St, Fixed 24) exist only as multi-site count evidence; the C&I plant contract 2d5449de-b450-47e8-adec-ecdb1a7063af is counted toward nothing in the site minimum (near-miss: C&I sites do not count) but drives the portfolio factors.

[Factor card - renewal rate 8.65, baseline 9.26] offer selection (method; notices both in window and final 9.26 > initial 9.18 -> start 9.18; baseline final rate -> 8.73); annual load 137,020 kWh -> -0.15 (baseline 8.80); load shape 13,140/11,418.33 = 1.151 -> -0.08 (8.73); same-site gas (cross-difficulty bizgas, XSUM over bizgas_billing of f5293ccf-2bf8-418f-ab44-c7bd221d631d) 6,565 therms -> -0.20 (8.85), near-miss: the 601-therm line posted 2025-10-07 excluded; tenure 35 months -> -0.06 (8.71); renewal history first renewal -> -0.04 (8.69). Multi-source: offer selection (notice dates AND rates; or of two notices).
[Factor card - multi-site 22.55, baseline 10.00] site load 13,140 kWh -> +4.00 (17.05); same-site gas (cross bizgas plan Fixed 24 active) -> +2.40 (19.25); continuity (parameter) 11 credits in 12 months -> multiplier value 1.25 (18.04); cycle length 33 days -> x33/30 (20.50).
[Factor card - closure fee 91.25, baseline 348.73] anchor drop effective 2026-10-16 -> 5 months (117.50); winding-down 2,625 vs 4,649.58 (ratio 0.565) -> 2,625 kWh/month (192.48); tenure 18 months -> 0.0100 (124.06); site-size minimum 4,976.92 dollars -> 125.00 (110.00); portfolio deduction (cross-difficulty cni, contract ends 2028-05-31, 19 months) -> 40.00 (131.25). The multi-source factor of this task is renewal_offer_selection (the two notices' dates and rates); the anchor and portfolio tiers each read a single record.
[Factor card - loyalty 341.65, baseline 100.00] spend method 11,705.98 -> 1.5% = 175.59 (258.50); commitment 36 months -> +40 (297.65); portfolio (cross cni active) -> +60 (275.65); supply continuity 12 lines -> +20 (319.65); decision bonus within opt-out window -> +15 (325.15); timing (parameter) 29 days -> multiplier value 1.10 (310.59).
Overwrites declared: bizpower_agg_multi_site amount sentence; bizpower_renewal acceptance-rate sentence and loyalty-credit sentence; bizpower_expiry_notices 'final_options_notice governs' sentence; bizpower_etf termination-date and per-kWh sentences. Everything else inherited (one credit per cycle, one fee per agreement, waivers, status gates).

[Seed] SEED-FRESH OH bakery group: customer 7e8896ab-d4ab-4bd0-ae7e-66e627af5142, five commercial AEP Ohio premises (account numbers ending 3417, 3528, 3691, 3306, 3872; gas account ending 3352), four bizpower agreements, 92 rows total. No sales tax (OH 0.000). Gas: Fixed 24 at High St with dual-commodity fee waiver (energy lines only, usage inside the 20 percent bandwidth of 550 therms/month). C&I: Fixed All-In plant contract active to 2028-05-31.
